long: Xenogears is a story-driven Japanese role-playing game following Fei Fong Wong across a sprawling sci-fi narrative of mecha, religion, and identity. Combat mixes a deathblow-combo system for on-foot characters with battles in giant robots called Gears. It was developed and published by Square for the PlayStation; this build runs via RetroArch with the SwanStation core.
name: Xenogears
